regime_context: The absolute-trend gate (the validated risk-control leg) is active and narrowed the investable universe to 5 eligible themes: Tech Hardware & Semis, Conglomerates & Exchange, Banks, High-Dividend Blue Chips, and Industrials & Infrastructure. Momentum ranks are a coincident focus lens (no forward edge), and the rotation radar shows a narrowing structure with Tech Hardware as the highest-ranked eligible theme. No crowding flags present.
emerging_watch: Watch for Diversified Miners (current rank 1, score 1.805, but not eligible) to become gate-eligible. If its durability_bar rises sufficiently to turn eligibility true while remaining a top-2 rank, it would signal a broadening of the trend universe. Retire watch if Diversified Miners stays ineligible by 2026-08-25.

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: The theme is gate-eligible (durability_bar 0.64, hurst trend), historically associated with lower drawdown risk. The trend discipline favours staying with themes that have passed the absolute-trend gate. The theme is not crowded, so no sizing caution is triggered from that leg.
theses.dissent: The theme could be a momentum trap if the gate fails to prevent a sharp reversal; Hong Kong tech is exposed to geopolitical shocks and US-China tensions, with the macro backdrop showing extremely high unscheduled surprise share (0.97) that could trigger sudden risk-off.

falsifier.text: A simple equal-weighted basket of the top-5 Hong Kong-listed hardware/semis stocks underperforms the Hang Seng Index by 5 percentage points or more by 2026-08-28.

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: The theme failed the absolute-trend gate (eligible=false), which historically meant higher volatility and deeper drawdowns. Avoidance reduces exposure to segments lacking the gate’s risk-control benefit, and the scorable ETF 3033.HK allows monitoring. This is a risk-control underweight, not a directional fade call.
evidence: durability_bar 0.52, hurst_tag trend but insufficient to pass gate
theses.dissent: China platform megacaps could rebound sharply on renewed policy stimulus or AI narrative tailwinds, and the trend may strengthen enough to activate the absolute-trend gate later. Avoiding a large liquid segment may forfeit upside in a rally.

falsifier.text: The ETF 3033.HK (proxy for China Platform Megacaps) outperforms the Hang Seng Index by more than 3% from 2026-08-04 to 2026-08-28.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
